Chapter 1248 - 9: Galaxy Great Saint, Why Don’T You Come Out Quickly For A Meeting (Requesting Guaranteed Monthly Vote At The Beginning Of The Month)

Chapter 1248: Chapter 9: Galaxy Great Saint, why don’t you come out quickly for a meeting (Requesting guaranteed monthly vote at the beginning of the month)

"Thank you, Ancestors."

Lin Yuan looked at the six Ancestors, including the Ancestor of Fierce Sun. All the Ancestors gave him gifts.

The rarity of these gifts was noteworthy even at the thirteenth rank, showing that each Ancestor had put in a lot of effort.

"I’m just curious, why did the Ancestors do this? Is it because of my future?" Lin Yuan asked, puzzled.

He originally thought that the six Ancestors were just visiting him casually, but the Primordial Ancestor of the Barbaric Wilderness directly suggested befriending as peers. Befriending as peers? This almost deemed Lin Yuan as the thirteenth rank.

Other Ancestors, including the Da Fu Ancestor, presented precious gifts. Such treatment left Lin Yuan puzzled.

Even though his future potential was immense, it didn’t seem necessary for the Ancestors to treat him this way. After all, the future is filled with countless variables and endless possibilities.

The future seen by the Ancestors may not necessarily occur.

So Lin Yuan straightforwardly asked to clarify why the Ancestors acted this way.

"Hahaha, Galaxy, you’re straightforward." The Primordial Ancestor of the Barbaric Wilderness looked at Lin Yuan, glancing at the surroundings where servants continually moved in and out.

The Ancestor of Fierce Sun waved his hand, and all the servants were moved outside the grand hall. What they were about to discuss next was of the thirteenth-rank Time Being level.

"It’s very simple." The Xuanyin Ancestor looked at Lin Yuan and said, "It’s because your future is almost certain to reach the thirteenth rank."

"Almost certain to reach the thirteenth rank?" Lin Yuan’s expression slightly changed.

"At least in the future timelines that a few of us have observed, Galaxy, you eventually step into the thirteenth rank, whether it happens sooner or later. It could be within tens of thousands or hundreds of thousands of years, or as long as millions or tens of millions of years. But ultimately, you step into the thirteenth rank."

"Indeed." The Da Fu Ancestor nodded, "Galaxy, little brother, don’t take this personally. I specifically observed some timelines where attempts were made to prevent and eliminate you, but they were useless. At most, they could only delay the time it takes for you to enter the thirteenth rank."

"Yes, I did the same. In the end, Galaxy, little brother, you returned and directly suppressed me." The Da Ling Ancestor nodded.

The thirteenth-rank Time Beings can observe many future timelines. Being suppressed in these instances means that in all the future timelines seen, there will be suppression and no chance of survival.

If there exists a single timeline where suppression can be avoided, a Time Being will choose that timeline.

"Return again?" Lin Yuan’s thoughts churned.

Regarding this point, Lin Yuan had no doubts. He possessed the Myriad Realms Gate, with life-preserving methods encompassing different dimensional spaces, a realm difficult for Time Beings to reach.

Even all six Ancestors could at most erase his presence in this Fang Yuan World but couldn’t completely kill him.

According to Lin Yuan’s character, if any Ancestor did make a move against him, after entering the thirteenth rank in the future, he would surely return to settle the score.

The spatial coordinates of this Fang Yuan World were recorded by the Myriad Realms Gate, allowing him to return at any time.

The future timelines seen by the Ancestors only confirmed that Lin Yuan couldn’t be killed, but could not determine the reason, understandably, as it involved the Myriad Realms Gate.

But for his future to be almost certain to reach the thirteenth rank?

"We don’t know what the exact reason is. Even Time Lords traversing various dimensional gaps are just starting to consolidate their timelines. We’ve never heard of a fixed future."

The Thunder Origin Ancestor looked at Lin Yuan and continued, "But no matter what, Galaxy, little brother, you will definitely step into the thirteenth rank, and in the distant future, reach great heights in that rank. If we don’t build relationships now, it will be too late in the future."

The other Ancestors nodded slightly. They were not hiding anything, and there was no malice, purely a desire to form friendships.

In the future timelines seen by the Ancestors, this was the best course of action. If they had hidden something at this time, using the information disparity against Lin Yuan to burden him with greater causality, there would be no goodwill when the Galaxy Venerate steps into the thirteenth rank and sees through everything.

The Ancestors, seeing one timeline after another, knowing they absolutely cannot be enemies of the Galaxy Venerate, naturally would strive to build a good relationship with Lin Yuan.

"We have no other requests, Galaxy, little brother, you don’t need to feel any pressure, just let’s be friends."

The Da Ling Ancestor said.

"I see."

Lin Yuan nodded, having no other thoughts about the Ancestors’ intention to befriend him.

Proactively visiting with gifts to clear obstacles for his cultivation and telling the truth, whatever the intention, Lin Yuan would appreciate this gesture.

"A determined future is not infallible."

Lin Yuan thought for a moment and said.

The future timelines seen by the six Ancestors are just a part, not the whole.

It only means that his chance of reaching the thirteenth rank is slightly higher than other beings.

"That’s true."

The Ancestors glanced at each other and nodded slightly.

So their explanation to Lin Yuan was that he was almost certain to step into the thirteenth rank.

Why ’almost’? Because they are not fourteenth-rank Perfect Time Beings, unable to observe all timelines, they couldn’t confirm that in unseen timelines, the Galaxy Venerate could still maintain such a determined future.

"Anyway, thank you, Ancestors."

Lin Yuan looked at the Ancestors, "If I do step into the thirteenth rank in the future, I won’t forget any of you."

"Hahaha." The Ancestors exchanged a knowing smile.

The reason they came together was to build a good relationship with the Galaxy Venerate? What they sought was merely for the future Galaxy Venerate to remember this kindness and refrain from hostile actions against them.
